3164a8c.summary: Stores a card's new description text and writes it into every description label of the card UI. Also re-selects the text layout (name only, name+description, tactic variants) for the new text. The decompiler merged a second layout-choosing method into the tail.
comments: The card's text controller owns the name/description labels and the layout states.
Remember the raw description string on the controller.
Loop over all description labels and set the new text on each (virtual setter call).
Decompiler glued a different method (CardTextsController SetArmy/SetStartingState) into this loop; ignore the odd bounds-check path.
Merged code: picks the starting layout from the card type (0x14 and 0x28 look like tactic/spell types).
Merged layout chooser: tactics pick a layout by spell type, other cards by whether the description is empty.
Only change layout if the target state differs from the current one.
Find the layout entry whose type matches the target and activate it; remember it as current.

3164aa4.summary: Switches the card's text layout for display in the player's hand, following the hand text setting (name only or description only). Called when a card enters or is shown in hand; changes the text controller's current layout state.
comments: Read the player's setting for what text hand cards show.
Minion with no description: only the name-only or description-only settings change anything.
Minion with a description: pick the matching simplified layout (5 = description only, 6 = name only).
Not a minion layout (a tactic/spell): pick tactic description-only (8) or name-only (7).
Common tail: skip if already in that layout, otherwise find the matching layout entry and toggle it on.
The rest is unrelated SetCardTextLayout code the decompiler glued on; it is not part of this method.

3164b14.summary: Switches the card to a simplified text layout (name only or description only) when option is true, or back to the initial layout when false. Changes the text controller's current layout state.
comments: Option off: skip straight to restoring the initial layout.
Minion without description: simplified view applies only for name-only or description-only settings.
Tactic cards: description-only or name-only layout depending on the setting.
Minion with description: name-only falls through to the simplified layout; description-only gets its own layout.
Minion simplified layout.
Common tail: skip if already in that layout, else find the matching entry and toggle it on.
Everything after this is unrelated SetCardTextLayout code merged in by the decompiler.

3164b30.summary: Turns the simplified card text view on by switching to the simplified layout that matches the card's initial layout. Changes the text controller's current layout state.
comments: Pick the simplified layout for this card kind: 6 for minion without description, 5 for minion with description, 8 for tactics.
Common tail: skip if already in that layout, else find the matching entry and toggle it on.
Everything after this is unrelated SetCardTextLayout code merged in by the decompiler.

3164b50.summary: Turns the simplified card text view off by restoring the card's initial text layout. Changes the text controller's current layout state.
comments: The target is simply the layout the card started with.
Skip if already in that layout, else find the matching entry and toggle it on.
Everything after this is unrelated SetCardTextLayout code merged in by the decompiler.

3164bd4.summary: Returns whether this card can be upgraded, by asking CardServices to check the raw card data. Used by the UI to decide whether to show upgrade options.
comments: Asks the card services if an upgraded version of this card exists; the out value is discarded here.

3164c48.summary: Shows the card back (option true, hides the front) or the card front (option false) on the 2D card controller. Called when a card is flipped face down or up.
comments: Show the back: hide the front object and enable the back container.
Show the front: enable the front object and disable the back container.
Shared tail: the decompiler lost the SetActive call on the back container; it sets it to the backVisible value.

3164c64.summary: Runs the pending callback that fires when the description is shown, then clears it so it runs only once.
comments: A callback is waiting: invoke it, then forget it.

3164c9c.summary: Enables the card's click collider and stores the click callback (touch-down or normal), plus remembers the collider size and whether touching should show the description.
comments: Needs the GameObject and its BoxCollider2D; enable the collider so the card can be clicked.
Choose which callback slot to fill: touch-down callback or regular click callback.
Record collider size and the show-description flag for later hit tests.

3164ec4.summary: Handles a finger/mouse press on the card: calls the touch-down callback with this card and, if description display is enabled, flags that a click began on a card in play.
comments: Notify whoever registered for touch-down, passing this card's GameObject.
If touching shows the description, mark that a click started on this in-play card.

3164f1c.summary: Tells every attack-type highlight on the card to refresh for the new attack type. The decompiler also merged in the card-image big/small tween code from a different method; only the loop at the end is this method.
comments: Loop over all attack-type highlight objects.
From here to the end of the loop is misplaced code from CardImageController (image big/small change); not part of this method.
Image state Big: swap to the instanced material, scale up and enable the mask.
Image state Small: restore original scale, clamp range and material.
Not instant: tween scale, clamp color and mask strength; instant: set them directly (line 134 on).
Real loop body: each highlight refreshes itself for the attack type.

3164f8c.summary: Changes the card image between big and small framing, either instantly or with DOTween tweens of scale, clamp-range color and mask strength. Used when a card image is enlarged or shrunk in its frame.
comments: Nothing to do if the image is already in that size state.
Big: use the instanced material, scale to original times the big multiplier, and enable the frame mask.
Small (or other): scale back to the original, use the small clamp range; mask is only removed right away if instant.
Kill any running tweens on the image, its material and the mask before starting new ones.
Instant: set scale, clamp vector and mask strength directly.
Animated: tween scale (with a completion callback when shrinking), clamp color and the mask effect strength property.

3163d94.summary: Enables or disables opening the full card display on click and adds or removes the card click listener on the UI event catcher accordingly.
comments: Remember the setting.
Always remove the existing listener first so it is never added twice.
Disabled: stop here, no listener.
Enabled: add the CardClicked listener again (decompiler inlined the UnityEvent add).

31642d8.summary: Shows or hides the new-card badge and, when shown with animation, pops it with a short scale tween.
comments: No badge object on this card: nothing to do.
Activate or deactivate the badge.
Only animate when it is being shown and animation was requested.
Scale tween (to about 1.1 over 0.35s) with an InOutSine ease: a small pop.

3164fa8.summary: Sets the Unity layer on the card object and all its children, then sets the sorting layer on renderers (the decompiler merged several helper methods into this one).
comments: Set the layer on the root object.
Loop over child transforms and set the layer recursively on each.
Exception cleanup for the enumerator (decompiler noise).
Merged in: GameStaticData SetSortingLayerRecursively, applying the sorting layer name to the object and children.
Merged in: SetSortingLayer on one object, which sets sortingLayerID on sprite/canvas renderers.
Look up the layer id from the sorting layer name and apply it to each renderer found.

316502c.summary: Sets the card's fade canvas group alpha if the card has one.
comments: Only act if a fade group exists; the alpha write itself was lost in decompilation.

31650c0.summary: Tints the card color through its group tint component, instantly if the tint duration is zero, otherwise with a color tween.
comments: No tint group on the card: nothing to do.
Make sure the tint component is enabled.
Zero duration: set the color immediately.
Otherwise kill the old tween and start a DOTween color tween to the new color.

316518c.summary: Tweens the card's alpha to a target value over a given time, with an optional start delay.
comments: Getter and setter delegates read and write the card's fade group alpha.
Create the float tween toward the target alpha.
Apply the delay, either as a sequence interval or as the tween's start delay.

31652c4.summary: Starts the coroutine that animates the changed gem amount text, only when origPosition is true. The coins amount is not used by the decompiled code.
comments: Nothing happens unless origPosition is true.
Build the coroutine and start it on this MonoBehaviour (null or non-MonoBehaviour cases throw).

31653c4.summary: Compiler-generated getter returning the fade canvas group's current alpha, used as the DOTween getter in FadeCard.
comments: Reads the fade group alpha; the actual return value was lost in decompilation.

3256d94.summary: Makes a copy of this board criteria and replaces the count criteria with its own deep copy so the two copies do not share it.
comments: Shallow clone first, then deep-copy the nested count criteria.

3256ed0.summary: Shows the card front or the card back by toggling the front object and the back container.
comments: Back: hide the front and show the back container.
Front: show the front and hide the back container; any other value does nothing.
Shared tail: the SetActive call on the back container was lost in decompilation.

3256f40.summary: Fades the card (or card back) highlight on or off by changing the alpha of the outline color, instantly or through a color-changer tween.
comments: Pick the card back shadow image and changer, or the front frame ones.
Target alpha is 1 when turning highlight on and 0 when off.
Make sure the changer has created its instanced material.
Instant: set the color on the material directly.
Animated: fill the changer with target and original colors and start a 0.2s fade.

3256ff0.summary: Changes the highlight color of the card or card back, instantly or through a timed color changer.
comments: Pick the card back changer or the front frame changer (decompiler lost the parameter names here).
Make sure the instanced material exists.
Animated: set up the changer with the new target color and a 0.2s duration.
Instant: set the color property on the material directly.

325702c.summary: Changes the shadow color of the card or card back, instantly or through a timed color changer.
comments: Pick the card back changer or the front frame changer (decompiler lost the parameter names here).
Make sure the instanced material exists.
Animated: set up the changer with the new target color and a 0.2s duration.
Instant: set the shadow color property on the material directly.

3257068.summary: Fades the card shadow on or off by changing the alpha of its shadow color, instantly or through a color-changer tween.
comments: Read the current shadow color from the frame material.
Target alpha is 1 for on and 0 for off.
Make sure the changer has created its instanced material.
Instant: write the color to the material directly.
Animated: set the changer's target and original colors and start a 0.2s fade.

32570e0.summary: Sets the card frame sprite on the frame image and the highlight sprite on the highlight/shadow image (Unity's Image sprite setter was inlined).
comments: Assign the frame sprite.
Inlined Image.sprite setter for the highlight image: nothing changes if it is the same sprite.
Update layout and material flags, set the sprite, mark the image dirty and track it.

3257120.summary: Toggles the glitch effect on the card frame. Mostly stubbed in the decompile: it only picks a value and the actual effect call was lost.
comments: Chooses one of two values (on or off) but the set call was lost.

3257158.summary: Sets the card back sprite and the card back shadow sprite (the image sprite setter was inlined).
comments: Assign the card back sprite.
Skip the shadow part if no shadow sprite was given.
Inlined Image.sprite setter for the shadow image: nothing changes if the sprite is the same.
Update flags, set the sprite, mark the image dirty and track it.

3257200.summary: Enables or disables every tooltip trigger on the card and its text tooltips. The decompiler appended the constructor's shader id code at the end.
comments: Loop over card tooltip triggers and toggle each.
Then loop over the text tooltips the same way.
Misplaced: this is the Card2DController constructor body (caches shader property ids), not part of this method.

32572bc.summary: Constructor: caches the shader property ids for the card's shadow color and outline (highlight) used by the fade code.
comments: Shader property ids are looked up once and reused for highlight and shadow fades.

3257348.summary: Decides whether an ability's trigger fires for the given cards: checks the trigger type, that this card is in the right zone, faith or spirit stone cost where relevant, then acting-card, target and board criteria. Called when a game event happens.
comments: Strike trigger: logs the check; fires only if the ability itself is a Strike ability.
Trigger type of the event must equal this ability's trigger.
These triggers (card played, unit death, codex, sacrifice, enchantment) skip the zone check.
High trigger ids: UseFaith and UseSpiritStone need the right zone and enough resource.
If this card is the actor, the owner must have at least 1 and at least the trigger value of that resource.
All other triggers: this card must be in the zone the ability's context requires.
Final checks: acting card, target card and board criteria must all pass.

32576ec.summary: Checks whether the card is in the zone the ability's context requires (in play, hand, deck, cemetery, in play or dying, in play or cemetery). Used to decide if a trigger may fire.
comments: Play, Hand and Deck contexts.
Play: card must be in play, not about to die from pending damage, and not a remnant.
Hand: card must be in hand.
Deck: card state must be the deck state (the mask test allows only that state).
Cemetery and combined contexts.
In play or dying: true if in play or in the dying state.
In play or cemetery: true if in the cemetery, else if in play.
Unknown context: logs a warning and never fires.
Cemetery: card state must be in cemetery.

3258260.summary: Clones this ability and deep-copies its criteria and its list of ability logic so the copy can be changed independently. The decompiler output is partly mangled.
comments: Shallow clone; the type-check mess after it is decompiler noise.
Deep-copy the acting-card and target criteria.
Build a new ability logic list and copy each logic entry into it.

32582e0.summary: Clones this ability and deep-copies its acting-card criteria, target criteria and ability logic list.
comments: Shallow clone first.
Deep-copy the acting-card and target criteria.
New logic list: each ability logic entry is deep-copied and added.

3258524.summary: Sets up a card animation: stores parents and animation info, optionally rotates toward a target, starts position tracking for moving effects, and hands acting and target cards to the VFX component.
comments: Remember where the animation starts and ends and which animation settings to use.
With a rotate-towards target, rotate the animation (unless set to orient to velocity).
If the VFX moves between two different parents, enable per-frame updates and record the start position and random offsets.
Give the VFX component the acting and target cards so its modules can use them.

3258728.summary: Rotates the animated card: toward the middle of the opponent's board (with an InBack tween) or straight at a target transform.
comments: Point-at-board-center option: use the span between the leftmost and rightmost minion on the other side.
Compute the angle toward that board center and tween the rotation over the animation time.
Apply the animation's start delay to the tween.
Otherwise just turn immediately to look at the target transform.

3258a48.summary: Per-frame update of a card animation: moves the object from start to end parent along the ease curve, adds random offsets, orients to velocity, and advances the animation clock.
comments: Only move while the clock is inside the animation's moving window.
Blend between start and end positions using the eased progress, clamped to 0 to 1.
Optionally add curve-driven random offsets on each axis.
If set to orient to velocity, face the direction of travel since the last frame.
Advance the animation clock by frame time.

325d1d4.summary: Static constructor creating the singleton instance of the compiler-generated closure class used by CardDeck lambdas.

325d244.summary: Lambda used by LegendaryCardsInDeck: true when the card is not a hero and has Legendary rarity.
comments: Heroes never count as legendary here.
